## MarketNow — trust layer for AI agents

MarketNow is a hosted MCP server that lets an agent verify any MCP tool *before* connecting to it. Concrete workflow: the agent (or its operator) calls `marketnow_verify_trust` with a server or skill name and receives an install-risk verdict backed by a 12-stage audit pipeline: 68k+ indexed servers, scam-domain checks, credential verification across 8 formats (API keys, JWTs, Ed25519 signatures), and revocation checks — exposed through 9 focused tools (`verify_trust`, `check_domain`, `fingerprint_tool`, `check_revocation`, ...). What distinguishes it: it is a registry-side trust layer with a free tier and no account required, not a client-side scanner — the same data powers marketnow.site and the public `/api/free-skills.json` endpoint. Security claims are evaluable end-to-end: the audit pipeline is documented and versioned (ATC/1.3) at `marketnow.site/api/mcp`, every verdict returns its per-stage evidence, and the whole verification flow can be reproduced with the public API without credentials.
